Input.Content: Kiln log: week A used controller X and recorded 12 cracked tiles in 100. Week B used controller Y and recorded 5 in 100. Clay batches and drying humidity differed between weeks. A same-controller X check also recorded 5 in 100 after a batch change. The team retained Y for a longer trial; it did not conclude that Y caused the reduction. The log contains no long-term durability measurements.

Idea.Title: Lower cracking merits another trial, not a causal victory
Idea.Description: Lower cracking merits another trial, not a causal victory
Idea.Rationale: Preserve observed conclusions and their limits.
